_schema_notes.roster: Enemy types and weaknesses follow Design Doc section 4.4. Schema follows Technical Design Doc section 2.3.
_schema_notes.scaling: Design Doc 4.4: base HP = 20 + (depth * 5) + (grid_size * 2); base damage = 5 + (depth * 2). base_hp/base_damage below are the depth-0 baselines; GridGenerator/CombatEngine apply the per-depth and per-size terms.
_schema_notes.asset_keys: visual/audio carry LOGICAL keys, not file paths, so lookups go through AssetRegistry (CLAUDE.md 2.3). No art or audio exists yet; missing keys degrade to placeholder + warning.
_schema_notes.weakness_types: word_property (computed from the answer, see WordProperties), clue_tag / not_clue_tag (read from the clue's `tags` in clues_master.json), exact_match (the boss: an accepted alternate answer deals penalty_multiplier; see boss_rounds.json).
_schema_notes.ability_modes: special_ability.effect.mode picks the implementation in EnemyAbilities: swap_solved_letters, reverse_answer, scale_remaining, mishear, blend. Abilities only fire at dungeon_depth >= unlock_depth, and each carries cooldown_turns (counted in attempts against that enemy type across the run).
_schema_notes.no_counter_on_hit: A boss flag: a correct answer that does not finish the enemy does not draw a counter-attack (only wrong answers and timeouts do), so a long multi-round fight is survivable.

enemies.name: The Anagram
enemies.description: A shapeshifting creature that scrambles the letters of solved words.

special_ability.name: Letter Swap
special_ability.description: Swaps 2 random solved letters on the grid

weakness.description: Words with double letters deal +50% damage

enemies.flavor_text: It speaks in tongues - all of them at once, and none of them correctly.

enemies.name: The Palindrome
enemies.description: A mirrored horror that reads the same coming and going.

special_ability.name: Mirror Input
special_ability.description: Reverses the player's submitted answer before validating it

enemies.flavor_text: Was it a car or a cat I saw?

enemies.name: The Homophone
enemies.description: It sounds exactly like something you already know, and means nothing of the sort.

special_ability.name: Mishearing
special_ability.description: Mishears the clue, swapping words for sound-alikes

weakness.description: Answers with a same-sounding twin (RAIN / REIGN) deal +50% damage

enemies.weakness_note: Design Doc 4.4 words this weakness as 'context clues', which is not computable. Read as: the Homophone is undone by answers that have a sound-alike (clues tagged homophone in clues_master.json) - see docs/adr/004-enemy-abilities-and-the-thesaurus.md.
enemies.flavor_text: It said its piece. Or perhaps its peace. You will never be sure.

enemies.name: The Acronym
enemies.description: A creature of initials, impatient with anyone who spells things out.

special_ability.name: Abbreviate
special_ability.description: Halves the remaining time on the clue timer

weakness.description: Full-word answers (anything that is not an abbreviation like NPC) deal +50% damage

enemies.flavor_text: T.L.D.R., it hisses, and takes another five seconds from you.

enemies.name: The Portmanteau
enemies.description: Two words fused at the seam, and angry about it.

special_ability.name: Blend
special_ability.description: Merges two clues into a single ambiguous prompt

enemies.flavor_text: It is not one thing. It is not two things. It is furious about the distinction.

bosses.name: The Thesaurus
bosses.description: The guardian of all words. It knows every synonym, antonym, and obscure variant.

phases.description: Changes the clue to a synonym mid-fight
Reverses the meaning of the clue

weakness.description: Only the exact answer deals full damage; an accepted alternate (e.g. the modern spelling in phase 3) deals half

bosses.flavor_text: It has a word for what you are about to become. Several, in fact.
